instr: Symmetry and squares: decide if each pattern is mirror-symmetric, and remember where the red squares appeared.
clue: Each step shows a black-and-white pattern: is it the same on the left and the right, like a mirror? Answer Yes (left arrow) or No (right arrow). Then a red square flashes in a grid: remember where. At the end, tap the squares in the order they appeared, then press Done. Press Start when ready.
phase_recall: Tap the squares in the order they appeared (arrow keys and Enter also work, Backspace undoes). Then press Done.
